data.long_meaning: Abiram (אֲבִירָם) is a name of Hebrew origin meaning “My father is exalted; the Exalted One is my father”. A compound of Hebrew אָב ('av) 'father' (with possessive yod) and the root רוּם (rum) 'to be high, exalted' - 'my father is exalted'. Its root is Hebrew אֲבִירָם (ʾAviram), from אָב ('av) 'father' + רוּם (rum) 'to be exalted, high'. Abiram is the anglicised form of Biblical Hebrew ʾAviram. It is distinct from Abram (אַבְרָם) - a distinct name, 'exalted father'.
